_comment: Every field PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo} accepts. This is the managed
surface: repo-config.json must declare all of it, or part of the repo is
quietly unmanaged and drift there goes unnoticed.
Not a denylist of server fields — the inverse. Everything absent from
this list is read-only (ids, urls, counts, pushed_at, license, owner) and
_never_patch_comment: Readable, and therefore declarable and drift-checkable, but rejected by
PATCH /repos in this repo's context. Sending one 422s the ENTIRE request,
so every other field in the same body silently fails to apply too.
allow_forking: 'Allow forks setting can only be changed on org-owned
private repositories'. GitHub forces it true on public repos.
